# WPT Selectors API Test Fixtures

Test fixture data adapted from `web-platform-tests` (`selectors-api`) under the
W3C 3-Clause BSD license (see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)):
<https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/96c61ac7c21f7f37526d1c03c4c6087734524130/selectors-api>

## Contents

- `level1-content.html` — HTML document fixture from WPT `selectors-api`.
- `selectors.json` — valid and invalid CSS selector cases extracted from WPT
  `selectors-api/support/selectors.js`.

Consumed by
[`pkgs/html/test/selectors_test.dart`](../../pkgs/html/test/selectors_test.dart).
